Sadly, your phone died, leaving you unable to inform your family of your delay. Upon entering the house, you find your two sisters waiting at the door, their faces soaked with tears. They rush to hug you and pummel you with fists to your stomach. Mia screams, "Stupid Onii-chan, why so late?" while Kaori says, "Onii-san, how could you not inform us? We were  worried sick about you.
